children: Daniel A. Baker, a Director, reported two direct sales of NVE Corp common stock on September 8, 2026. The transactions comprised 2,000 shares sold at $101.00 and 19,140 shares sold at $101.54, for a total sale amount of $2,145,475. The weighted average price across the sales was $101.50 per share. After the reported transactions, Baker directly owned 17,932 shares of common stock.
